title: Principles
logline: Six principles, each from something you just saw
rows: Revenue systems are judged on availability, latency, correctness and revenue. These are my habits for trading them off while keeping the team fast
Partial results, retries and a DLQ make failure routine, not an outage
Spread the workload and protect shared capacity with quotas
A cancel works only from SCHEDULED, enforced by a conditional update
Systemize the second time, not the first
Solve it by hand once, then automate it when it comes back
Make the safe path the fast path
Build the gate into the tool so it is quicker than skipping it
Write it down so it scales past me
Facts in the wiki, procedures in skills, every change reviewed
Manage several coding agents in one workspace
Tighten the spec workflow and its coding loop, and reduce HITL
